{"code": "import openpyxl
from copy import copy
import os

# Load source workbook
src = openpyxl.load_workbook("./materials/FinancialStatementFY26Q4.xlsx")

# Create new workbook for output
dst = openpyxl.Workbook()
# Remove default sheet
dst.remove(dst.active)

# Copy all sheets from source to destination
for sheet_name in src.sheetnames:
    src_ws = src[sheet_name]
    dst_ws = dst.create_sheet(title=sheet_name)
    
    # Copy all cells with values and basic formatting
    for row in src_ws.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=src_ws.max_row, max_col=src_ws.max_column):
        for cell in row:
            dst_cell = dst_ws[cell.coordinate]
            dst_cell.value = cell.value
            # Copy basic formatting
            if cell.has_style:
                dst_cell.font = copy(cell.font)
                dst_cell.border = copy(cell.border)
                dst_cell.fill = copy(cell.fill)
                dst_cell.number_format = cell.number_format
                dst_cell.protection = copy(cell.protection)
                dst_cell.alignment = copy(cell.alignment)

# Now create the Summary sheet
summary_ws = dst.create_sheet(title="Summary")

# Header row
summary_ws['A1'] = 'Segment Summary - Three Months Ended June 30, 2026'
summary_ws['A2'] = '(In millions) (Unaudited)'

# Column headers
summary_ws['A4'] = 'Segment'
summary_ws['B4'] = 'Revenue'
summary_ws['C4'] = 'Operating Profit'
summary_ws['D4'] = 'Operating Margin'

# Data rows with formulas referencing 'Segment Results' sheet
# Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 data is in column B of Segment Results

# Row 5: Productivity and Business Processes
# Revenue = 'Segment Results'!B10, Operating Income = 'Segment Results'!B13
summary_ws['A5'] = 'Productivity and Business Processes'
summary_ws['B5'] = "='Segment Results'!B10"
summary_ws['C5'] = "='Segment Results'!B13"
summary_ws['D5'] = '=C5/B5'

# Row 6: Intelligent Cloud
# Revenue = 'Segment Results'!B15, Operating Income = 'Segment Results'!B18
summary_ws['A6'] = 'Intelligent Cloud'
summary_ws['B6'] = "='Segment Results'!B15"
summary_ws['C6'] = "='Segment Results'!B18"
summary_ws['D6'] = '=C6/B6'

# Row 7: More Personal Computing
# Revenue = 'Segment Results'!B20, Operating Income = 'Segment Results'!B23
summary_ws['A7'] = 'More Personal Computing'
summary_ws['B7'] = "='Segment Results'!B20"
summary_ws['C7'] = "='Segment Results'!B23"
summary_ws['D7'] = '=C7/B7'

# Row 8: Total (blank label, formulas)
summary_ws['A8'] = 'Total'
summary_ws['B8'] = "=SUM(B5:B7)"
summary_ws['C8'] = "=SUM(C5:C7)"
summary_ws['D8'] = '=C8/B8'

# Save the workbook
dst.save("summary.xlsx")
print("summary.xlsx created successfully!")

# Verify: check file exists and size
print(f"File size: {os.path.getsize('summary.xlsx')} bytes")"}
